methodology: Every factual claim in the supplier rows was read this session on a retrieved page — official supplier site first, government/association registry second, marketplace listing last and always labeled. Facts not stated on retrieved pages are recorded as null (Unknown); quote-only is recorded as a quote-only price tier. IndiaMART-listed price signals carry tier marketplace-listed with their canonical listing URLs and are never presented as supplier-published. Self-reported superlatives and metrics are flagged as self-reported. No emails, phones, prices, MOQs or certifications were guessed.
